items.title: 61124_Mario Bauza oral history interview
items.q: The first number that I recorded with Machin... I worked with him... and I played with him... Machin had a quartet... So one day I was with him in his house

ctx.x: What -- do you remember what the recording was?

The first number that I recorded with Machin, I can never forget, called La Parumbeda. I can never forget that time because it was my first time to record, and it was a hit song. So I keep messing around with the trumpet. Then I fall in love with trumpet, and I want to play like (inaudible) so bad I can taste it. So I got whole -- all his records, and I follow and play just like, you know, and copy and everything. All right.
So I got me a chance to fool around with the bands, small bands with the trumpet. I used to play gigs. I say, get a man on the trumpet, I get on the sax. I give up the sax
